prefix01.interpretation: The single-symbol witness rules out stock-pool competition as the main prefix01 loss. The dominant gap is risk deleveraging followed by a persistent same-live-cycle veto on later native Turtle participation. Historical full retention is not admissible evidence because its max drawdown is 18.3413667487%, above the frozen 18% contract.

failed_family_exclusion.target_r: Previously rejected target-r restored tactical partial-reduction quantity after recovery. This new test does not restore old shares, keep a target quantity, or credit a prior trim as future funding.

hypothesis.name: episode_scoped_confirmed_shock_pyramid_veto
hypothesis.mechanism: For books reduced by a confirmed systemic shock, keep native Turtle pyramid adds blocked while the real shock episode is active. Once that episode is no longer active, stop applying the extra confirmed-shock categorical veto and let a later native Turtle pyramid proposal flow through the unchanged current close-known gross/gap/shock/account budget. Crowded-portfolio shock-reduced vetoes remain unchanged. No previous quantity is restored, no synthetic order is created, and no prior sale is treated as cash before execution.
hypothesis.causal_discriminator: A later native strategy proposal plus an inactive shock episode and current account capacity is new close-known decision evidence; prior risk reduction alone creates no right to rebuy.
hypothesis.unchanged: 18% drawdown contract, data, seeds, scenarios, fees, board lots, T+1, ADV, limits, next-open execution, actual ownership/cash/pending obligations, HWM, cycle locks, loss history and all other risk/admission rules.

engineering: RED: exact C must currently block a confirmed-shock-reduced Turtle pyramid after shock_episode_active=false.

GREEN: keep the block while shock_episode_active=true; keep crowded shock-reduced veto unchanged; after inactive episode use the ordinary current budget rather than unconditional zero; no synthetic target/restoration state.
